build-station.title: Build an HF station
build-station.prompt: Put the station's boxes in order from the transceiver to the antenna.

blocks.label: Low-pass filter
blocks.does: passes the operating frequency and blocks harmonics

blocks.label: SWR meter
blocks.does: shows whether the antenna system is matched

blocks.label: Antenna tuner
blocks.does: matches the antenna system to the transmitter

blocks.label: Antenna switch
blocks.does: selects the antenna or the dummy load

blocks.label: High-pass filter
blocks.does: blocks low frequencies; it belongs on a TV, not here

blocks.label: S-meter
blocks.does: shows received signal strength; it lives inside the receiver

hints: The filter goes first, straight after the radio.
The SWR meter goes right after the low-pass filter; the switch is last before the antennas.
build-station.success: Transceiver, low-pass filter, SWR meter, tuner, antenna switch. Harmonics are filtered as close to the radio as possible.

build-amp.title: Add an amplifier
build-amp.prompt: This station has an external amplifier. Where does the low-pass filter go now?

blocks.label: SWR meter
blocks.does: shows whether the antenna system is matched

blocks.label: Antenna tuner
blocks.does: matches the antenna system to the transmitter

blocks.label: Antenna switch
blocks.does: selects the antenna or the dummy load

hints: The amplifier makes harmonics too. The filter has to come after it.
build-amp.success: The filter now sits right after the amplifier, so it catches the amplifier's harmonics as well.
